nom: Beekman 1802 Potato Peel Rapid Resurfacing Milk Facial

avis.texte: This resurfacing milk facial is really easy to apply! It doesn't take a lot to cover your face. It dried quickly too. I left it on for about 10 minutes and then removed it. It left my skin feeling very soft and it seemed like my moisturizer soaked in much better after using this.
Literally the BEST facial ive had! I could tell a difference within two uses of this stuff. My skin is softer and brighter! I could also tell a difference in my skin texture as well!

I got the 0.5 oz bottle to try it, which is only about 4-5 uses, but I had some acne scars on my cheeks and this stuff made a dramatic difference after 4 uses. Its gentle enough to still use other products with actives in it afterwards, I use the Tula acne set everyday and using that with this peel twice a week has improved my 37 yo hormonal acne sooo much! I highly recommend this peel!
After just 3 uses I'm already seeing a change in my skin for the better

avis.titre: Great product that does exactly what it says.
avis.texte: I purchased this during a sale to try & I'm so glad that I did. It's a great facial peel that I use once a week to brighten & soften my skin. I use it at night after washing my face & leave it on for about 30 minutes, then rinse off & put on a heavy moisturizer to sleep in. I have sensitive, combination skin & I haven't had any negative issues. Like some of the comments say, it does have a smell & it can sting a bit when you apply it, but I'm ok with that because I prefer natural ingredients that do what they say rather than some product full of fragrances.

avis.titre: Product is good, but smells bad
avis.texte: I like the way my face looks and feels after using the potato peel rapid resurfacing milk facial, but I do not like the smell.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: It didn't make my face dry and I have sensitive skin. So far it's working great. I like the way my face looks after I rinse it off.

It does soften the skin, but I wouldn't say that it really exfoliates and it's really hard to get past the smell and texture many other products out there with similar formulations that don't smell like plastic. Doesn't stain your skin long enough to too much of anything but leave a residue that make your skin soft but smells. the smell it makes me concerned.

I can't imagine how extremely dry and sensitive your skin would have to be to only use this as a weekly 10 minute peel instead of a daily overnight peel! It even works well with retinoids! My skin is oily, resistant, and used to acids. My face has always been very soft and smooth – but it has recently become seriously coarse and leathery due to illness… so I wore this all night every night for a week, and it's already so much better! I'm still wearing it every night, and it's incredibly gentle – but still effective! It doesn't cause the least bit of stinging, burning, or discomfort like a real chemical peel.

avis.titre: Suffer from textured skin no more!
avis.texte: My favorite part of the Beekman potato peel is the combo of exfoliating glycolic acid & smoothening lactic acid with an all natural delivery system of potato pulp. Basically, this is a gentle yet clinically effective solution for anyone suffering from troubled skin with texture. It has done wonders for my skin and I could not imagine my full routine without it

Forget the other ordinary peels. You get what uoi pay for and this is worth every penny. Would I pay full price, probably not. But I will always buy this as long as I can use a coupon. I see a more even brighten skin tone after just one use.

If your skin is oily/resistant like mine (the opposite of dry/sensitive), this is still a very-gentle-but-effective skin peel… but only if you wear it for at least 8 hrs straight! Seriously, try sleeping in it! It works great as an overnight peel for skin that is oily/resistant &/or already used to stronger acid regimens – but, as always, patch test all new products first!

after years of dealing with adult acne and finally getting it under control. I figured it'd have been a year and I might as well try a peel. I can't even begin to explain literally my pores were cleaning themselves. I used one of my facetal tools to lightly scrape the peel off and I don't think I've ever felt my skin look and feel so amazing! I would've spent double on this product it's that good!

I definitely want to be honest with this review. I don't necessarily feel that this IS NOT a good product.... I feel like it depends on where you are in your "facial routine journey." I am a consistent "utilizer" of 20% glycolic acid pads. I tolerate them well. Perhaps this is why this product, which includes 15% glycolic acid, does not seem very effective to my skin. With that being said, I only used it once......! I might try again, but I think that the concentration of glycolic acid might not be potent enough for me.

I absolutely love this stuff. It took me a while to find something that would work. I use this one to two times a week my face glows and I get so many compliments. I work in a factory and I live on a farm and this keeps my face clean

Saw results after 1 use! Left it on for the full time but probably should have started with much less. My skin is sensitive so I experienced some stinging when I put my mouisturizer on. But it truly is absolutely amazing and my face feels so soft!

avis.titre: You know it's great if you don't care how it smells
